$comment: Literal -> replacement map for scrubbing real identifiers out of this repo.
Applied by .tooling/scrub.py. Longest key is applied first, so a longer literal
always wins over a shorter one that is a substring of it.
Replacements are one-way and no replacement contains any key, so the map is idempotent.
Where a length or a hash could depend on the string, the replacement is length-matched.
Length-matched:  no. Length differs but only ever appears in prose / comments:  see 'length_note'.

length_note.SHEET_ID_PLACEHOLDER: id placeholders are deliberately not length-matched; nothing hashes a spreadsheet or Drive id
length_note.OWNER_CHAT_ID: chat id is compared for equality only, never hashed or length-checked
length_note.CRED_GSHEETS: credential ids are opaque n8n references; not hashed
length_note.Owner: 'Ali Rad' (7) -> 'Owner' (5). Appears only in markdown prose (version-history author) - no hash, no length assertion
length_note.Riverside: 'Garden City' (11) -> 'Riverside' (9). Appears only inside JS comments and markdown prose - no hash, no length assertion
length_note.emails: length-matched (27/27, 26/26, 27/27 with case preserved) because WF4 delivery-key FNV-1a hashes the recipient address
length_note.1L0q0m...UknW: an ABBREVIATED form of the real sheet id, written by hand in a WF1 sticky note (6 real leading characters). It survived the first scrub because the map only held the full 44-character id, and leak-check only grepped for that. Both were extended on 2026-08-25.
